[LSIG.1.4.3] `onset_rate` is admitted only on `Bool` slots under `sliding`.
The compiler must reject a wrong element type with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TYPE_MISMATCH` and a wrong time model with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TIME_MODEL_MISMATCH` — the applicability diagnostics
for every signal aggregation (`active_fraction`, `onset_rate`, `integral`).
